question: When should construction of the eastern house be begun according to the sun's position?
premises: The sun may be in Aquarius.
The sun may be in Capricorn.
These times are linked to beginning the eastern house.
inference: One should begin the eastern house when the sun is in Aquarius or Capricorn.
plain_english: When the sun is in Aquarius or in Capricorn, one should begin the eastern house.
